description: Spec 002 — event/app core permissions. Spec 050 — the WebView holds NO shell spawn/kill: the Rust core alone manages the Ollama sidecar. Spec 010 — adds shell.open scoped to the GitHub Releases URL for the About-section link. Spec 016 — adds dialog:allow-open for the per-zone native file picker (file-open only; no save, no arbitrary fs read). No http, no shell beyond the scoped URL.
